notes.title: Elroy's Soundtrack OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[p]Dear adventurers! 
[/p][p]Immerse yourself in [b]over an hour[/b] of original music by [b]award-winning composer[/b] and music producer [b]Martin Bezjak[/b], created to accompany the wonderfully heartfelt journey of Elroy and Peggie across time and space. 🎸[/p][p][/p][p]This [b]38-track[/b] score blends lush orchestral ambiences, dark Americana textures, emotionally charged melodies, and heart-pounding cinematic climaxes.[/p][p][/p][p]From subtle moments to grand storytelling peaks, the soundtrack captures the full emotional arc of the game. ❤️[/p][p][/p][p]Also featured are two original songs co-written by [b]Tadej Gregorcic[/b]:[/p][p]🎵 "Crimson Sky" feat. [b]Malidah[/b][/p][p]🎵 "Desert Man" feat. [b]Žan Videc[/b][/p][p][/p][p]With special guest [b]Luka Šulić[/b] on cello. 🎻

[u]Carefully mastered for premium listening in both [b]MP3[/b] and [b]24-bit FLAC[/b] formats.[/u]
[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Video: Martin Bezjak and [b]Danilo Kapel[/b] from Epix Soundworks tell the story behind the creation of Elroy's rich soundscape.[/h3][previewyoutube="4iVYrzT-sAo;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]💡 Enjoy a special [b]25% launch discount[/b] during the first [b]two weeks[/b] after release!  [/p][p][/p][p]Let us know how you like the music in the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/1082190/discussions/0/?snr=2___"]Steam Discussions forum[/url]![/p][p] [/p][p]Thanks for listening!
- [b]Team Elroy[/b][/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3786780/Elroy_and_the_Aliens_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Elroy and the Aliens is OUT NOW! 🚀
notes.content:
[i]"It's very rare that you get a chance to become part of a story ... and sometimes what you find makes it all worth it." — Peggie Wolfe, Elroy and the Aliens[/i]

Friends! 👋

At Motiviti, we began this journey more than a decade ago as a small team with big dreams. Today, we're proud to present to you our hand-drawn adventure game [b]Elroy and the Aliens![/b] 🛸

[h3]🎥 Launch Trailer[/h3]

[previewyoutube=CaPFEa4QJ0w;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]🕹️ Game Features[/h3]

Set in the year [b]1993[/b], the game follows Elroy, a young rocket engineer haunted by the mysterious disappearance of his archaeologist father. Joined by Peggie, a sharp-witted investigative journalist with a particular knack for languages, Elroy embarks on an [b]odyssey from Slope City to a strange alien planet in search of the truth[/b].

[list]
[*]A [b]story-driven point-and-click adventure[/b] game for both modern and classic audiences, set in an altered version of the 1990s with intelligent robots, paranormal activities and an ancient archaeological mystery.
[*] [b]Multiple playable characters[/b].
[*] [b]Intriguing and challenging puzzles[/b].
[*] Story full of [b]mystery, character development, ancient legends, alien language[/b] and occasional pop culture references.
[*] Spanning [b]2 planets, 60 locations[/b] and featuring more than [b]60 characters[/b].
[*] [b]High-resolution, hand-drawn 2D art and animations[/b] with an old-school vibe and modern polish.
[*] [b]Fully-voiced characters[/b] and [b]original music score[/b] for an immersive movie-like experience.
[*] Designed with accessibility in mind with helpful captions for color-based puzzles, subtitles, and different input options.
[*] Approx. [b]10+ hours of gameplay[/b], depending on your playing style.
[/list]

[h3]⭐ Price + Launch Discount[/h3]

The game is available on Steam for [b]$17.99[/b].

Enjoy a special [b]10% launch discount[/b] during the first [b]two weeks[/b] after release! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1082190/Elroy_and_the_Aliens/

If you like the game, please consider leaving a [b]review on Steam[/b]. It truly helps a lot. 🙏

A sincere [i][b]thank you[/b][/i] to all of you who have been part of this journey and supported us along the way! ❤️ 

See you in Slope City, and safe travels though the cosmos! 🚀

[b]-Team Elroy[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790167/2ca9cb45d4c24deacd638f35f9e848d6efb087c3.png[/img]

notes.title: Blasting off: Elroy and the Aliens Launches on April 2nd!
notes.content:
Hi friends!

Only [b]5 more days to go[/b] until the release of [i]Elroy and the Aliens[/i]! A big thanks to all of you who've played the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3144250/Elroy_and_the_Aliens_Demo/]Demo[/url] so far and left such amazing reviews. We are truly overwhelmed by your enthusiasm and positivity and can't wait to show you the whole game. ❤️

[h3]🎯 Mark Your Calendars[/h3]

Yes! [i]Elroy and the Aliens[/i] is [b]coming to Steam on April 2nd, 2025[/b]. 
Sharpen your wits and get your clicking fingers warm and ready! 
We'll be pushing the release button at: [b]18:00 CET / 5 pm GMT / 9 am PT / 12 pm ET[/b].

Elroy (voiced by [b]Jay Rincon[/b]) and Peggie (voiced by [b]Dev Joshi[/b]) arrive at [i]Crazy Fred's diner[/i] in a desert ghost town. Featuring also: an old banjo, a beaten-up Telecaster, and a rusty slide guitar — the perfect musical backdrop for a dusty desert stop, [b]composed and arranged by Martin Bezjak[/b] from [url=https://epixsoundworks.com/]Epix Soundworks[/url]. 🌵

[previewyoutube=UpLmuCS_x-M;full][/previewyoutube]

Set in the year [b]1993[/b], the game follows Elroy, a young rocket engineer haunted by the mysterious  disappearance of his archaeologist father. Joined by Peggie, a sharp-witted investigative journalist with a particular knack for languages, Elroy embarks on an [b]odyssey from Slope City to a strange alien planet in search of the truth[/b].

[list]

[*] [b]Multiple playable characters[/b].

[*] [b]Intriguing and challenging puzzles[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40790167/b64c471c9a58576a39ee2ef422592540ab10eefb.png[/img]

The game will be available on Steam for [b]$17.99[/b].
 
There are so many of you who have been patiently waiting and supporting us through all those years. As a thank you, we're setting up a launch [b]discount of 10% for the first two weeks after release![/b] 

Friends, we couldn't have done it without you!❤️
See you in [b]Slope City[/b] on [b]April 2nd[/b]! 

[b]-Team Elroy[/b]

notes.title: Play Elroy's Top Rated Demo on Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hey Friends! Time to [b]play the Demo on Steam Next Fest[/b] (Feb/24th - Mar/3rd) starting today!
Thank you so much for all your overwhelmingly amazing reviews so far! 😍

[h2]What's in the Demo? [/h2]

Here's a little side-questy sneak peek! :) 

[previewyoutube=v9gjmnh4QlQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Game Features[/h2]

🎭 A [b]story-driven[/b] point-and-click adventure game for both modern and classic audiences, set in an altered version of the 1990s with intelligent robots, paranormal activities, and an ancient archaeological mystery.

🎨 High-resolution, [b]hand-drawn 2D[/b] art and animations with an [b]old-school vibe[/b] and [b]modern polish[/b].

🔊 [b]Fully-voiced[/b] characters by A-list actors in English (such as Jay Rincon, Dev Joshi and many others) and an [b]original music[/b] score (composed by Martin Bezjak and Epix Soundworks) for an immersive [b]movie-like experience[/b].

🧩 Intriguing and challenging [b]puzzles[/b].

🪐 Spanning [b]2 planets[/b], [b]60 locations[/b], and featuring more than [b]60 characters[/b].

👥 [b]Multiple[/b] playable characters.

📝 [b]Subtitles[/b] in German (by Marcel Weyers), Spanish (by Concha Fernández Álvarez), French (by Christophe Pallarès), Portuguese-Brasil (by Rômulo Wehling) and English as the original language.

[h2]The Game's Mission[/h2]

Why did we start hand-crafting Elroy 11 years ago? We wanted to revive that special feeling that happens only once, when you're a kid. When the eyes are wide open and full of wonder. When you're sitting in the living room on a Saturday morning and play THAT game on your parents' PC for the first time.  🤩

[h2]Demo Feedback[/h2]

If you'd like to share your thoughts or feedback on the Demo with us, we have a nifty Steam Forum thread [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1082190/discussions/0/598519418380617113/]right here[/url] for you. Also, we'll keep the Demo live after Next Fest so you can try it when it suits you.

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]

The countdown has begun! Elroy and the Aliens is launching 37 days from today, on [b]April 2nd, 2025! [/b]🚀

You've been suggesting and we've been listening! 🙌 We've been making improvements all along to make Elroy the best point & click adventure game we can. The game is now 99.9908% complete! We will keep polishing the cutlery to be 100% ready when we invite you to dig in and get the game fresh and hot on it's release on April 2nd!   

You'd like to keep in touch with us? [b]Follow Elroy on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/elroythegame.com]Bluesky[/url], [url=https://x.com/ElroyTheGame]X[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/wmmDgwAust]Discord[/url][/b]! We love to chat. 

Thank you! ❤️

- Team Elroy

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3144250/Elroy_and_the_Aliens_Demo/
